recommendations.title: Increase adoption
recommendations.body: Adoption is currently modelled at 75%. A focused enablement programme for the target user base is usually the single cheapest way to raise value on a product that is already built.
recommendations.impact: Raising adoption to 90% would increase 3-year value by approximately SGD 8.1K.

recommendations.title: Pilot before requesting full investment
recommendations.body: The evidence base is thin, held back mainly by financial validation. A 90-day pilot on a single segment would convert the largest assumptions from estimates into measured baselines.
recommendations.impact: Stage-gating the investment protects SGD 172K of build spend until the value hypothesis is tested.

recommendations.title: Compress the benefit ramp
recommendations.body: 2 benefit lines take a year or more to reach full run-rate. Sequencing the highest-value user segment first pulls value into the payback window.
recommendations.impact: A 40% faster ramp is worth approximately SGD 21.7K over three years and shortens payback.

insights.text: 78 products generate 78% of portfolio value. Concentration this high means portfolio performance is really the performance of a handful of products.

9% of portfolio value sits in 51 products where most of the annual value still rests on estimated (not measured or piloted) evidence. That is SGD 11.2M that needs stronger evidence before it belongs in a financial plan.
Revenue is the largest source of annual value at SGD 32.3M. This is the value story to lead with.
SGD 1.5M of forecast value is not yet realised across 14 products in production — a realisation rate of 85%. Use the variance to recalibrate assumptions on the products still in business case.
